description.value: Acquafarina is a Michelin Guide-recommended Italian fine dining restaurant in the heart of downtown Vancouver, operated by the Perse Hospitality Group. The kitchen specializes in modern Italian cuisine made from scratch with locally sourced ingredients, spanning handmade pasta, fresh seafood, Wagyu beef, and a curated caviar program. A polished bar program, weekend brunch, private event spaces, and a unique Liquor Locker membership add to its reputation as one of Vancouver's most refined dining destinations.
